pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregular dark regions with sharp pixel gradients at the margins. Relative spatial area is maximal at the lower neck and anterior flank, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous negative-space web of light-cream pathways. Junction nodes consist of tri-way and quadri-way intersections. Pixel thickness is narrow and uniform across the flank, broadening at the ventral transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the superior margin of the neck, exhibiting fine textural spikes against the background.
